clips.title: The story
paras: Behind Dolanaar's inn, Zarrin teaches the ways of Kaldorei cooking. He tends an open hearth on Teldrassil, where young night elves and visitors learn to prepare meals from the tree's native flora and fauna.

Behind Dolanaar's inn, Zarrin tends an open cooking fire and teaches Kaldorei culinary arts. Teldrassil's native plants and animals provide food for those who live here. Zarrin shows visitors how to forage and prepare meals at home.
